_README: MAINNET authority assignment for the Dominion SILV launch. Confirmed by Thomas 2026-07-26.
This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the mainnet deploy ceremony. Every one of
these decisions is IRREVERSIBLE or expensive to undo, so they are recorded here rather
than typed at a terminal. Verify with: scripts/verify-mainnet-authorities.ts
These are PUBLIC KEYS. Publishing them is safe (they are on-chain regardless) and
desirable: anyone can check that the deployed program's authorities match what was
announced. No secret material belongs in this file, ever.

ops_admin.role: config.admin. Day-to-day operations: premint, param setters, proposing timelocked actions.
_vault_vs_multisig: VERIFIED ON MAINNET 2026-08-11: this account is owned by the System Program, holds 5.1 SOL and
has ZERO bytes of data. That is a Squads VAULT PDA. It is the right value for config.admin.
IT IS THE WRONG VALUE FOR NEXT_PUBLIC_OPS_SQUADS. That env var wants the MULTISIG account, a
different pubkey, and pasting the vault there makes adminAuthority() derive a vault OF the vault:
a third address that is not config.admin, so every proposal the panel builds targets the wrong
signer. With the var unset instead, isConfigured("ops") is false and every Squads action in the
panel is DISABLED, which on mainnet means no premint, no add-guardian and no unpause.
The multisig address is recorded in ops_squads_multisig below. It could not be recovered from
chain: the vault has only ever received USDC transfers, never a Squads interaction, so nothing in
its history names its own multisig. Read it from the Squads UI.

upgrade_equals_compliance.what: upgrade_authority and compliance are the SAME vault (FqFNX...), and it is also the guardian.
upgrade_equals_compliance.why_it_matters: SolidProof TrustNet MEDIUM #1 is precisely 'these must be split across separate multisigs'. A compromise of FqFNX can replace the program with arbitrary code AND freeze or seize any holder's balance. That is the complete-takeover scenario the audit named, lacking only the ops_admin role, which an arbitrary upgrade can grant itself anyway.
upgrade_equals_compliance.what_it_DOES_still_defend: CORRIGE LE 2026-08-11, et l ancienne phrase etait fausse. Elle disait: ops_admin est genuinement separe, donc s il tombe, FqFNX peut vetoer ses actions timelockees comme gardien et reparer le programme comme upgrade authority. MESURE: les DEUX vaults sont des Squads 3/5 avec LES MEMES CINQ MEMBRES. Donc ce qui atteint 3 signatures sur l ops atteint 3 signatures sur le gardien au meme instant, et le veto n est pas independant de ce qu il vete. CE QUI TIENT REELLEMENT: la compromission d UNE ou DEUX cles membre n atteint aucun des deux seuils, et c est le cas le plus probable. A TROIS cles, il ne reste que le delai de 24h lui-meme, et seulement pour les actions qui en portent un: aucune separation de pouvoir ne subsiste. CE QUI FERMERAIT: un jeu de signataires DISTINCT sur au moins un vault. Le document SolidProof le propose explicitement et attend leur reponse.
upgrade_equals_compliance.recommendation: Separate upgrade_authority from compliance before material value accrues. Compliance is a WARM key (it gets exercised in response to legal orders); an upgrade authority should be COLD, used rarely, and ideally renounced once the code is final. A third vault, or renouncing upgradeability post-launch, closes this.
upgrade_equals_compliance.status: ACCEPTED for launch by Thomas 2026-07-26, with the split tracked as a follow-up.

_pregenerated_mint_note: LOCKED 2026-08-11 by the owner. A vanity address: the `i` is lowercase because Solana base58
has no capital `I` (nor `0`, `O`, `l`), so `SILV` in capitals is not a possible prefix for
anyone, us included. The secret key lives at ~/.config/solana/dominion-silv-mint.json, mode
600, on the ceremony machine only, and t1-hostile-bootstrap.ts consumes it via
THIS FIELD EXISTS TO BE COMPARED. The address is announced publicly (Jupiter pre-validation)
before the token exists, so a wrong keypair file at ceremony time would create the token at an
address nobody was told about. T1 now refuses unless the supplied keypair derives to exactly
this value; the earlier guard only caught a keypair file present with the env var unset.
WHAT THE PREFIX DOES NOT DO: authenticate. `SiLV` is four characters and a lookalike mint
costs about 90 seconds of grinding. Only the full address identifies the token.

launch_posture.max_silv_supply: 150000000000 (150,000 oz at 6dp). CONFIRMED Thomas 2026-07-29. Set by DEFAULT_MAX_SILV_SUPPLY in state/config.rs, NOT an initialize arg, so it must be right before the mainnet build. TIGHTEN-ONLY and a ONE-WAY RATCHET: lowering it makes the lower value the new permanent ceiling.
_premium_note: 1% mint / 1.5% redeem, confirmed by Mark 2026-07-30. These ARE initialize arguments,
so these are the values to type at the ceremony; the DEFAULT_PREMIUM_* constants in
state/config.rs are kept in sync only for scripts and tests.
Both hard ceilings are now 5% (mint was 3%), raised 2026-08-05. Both premiums stay
24h-timelock changeable after launch, so neither number is locked in.
The fee is 1% OF WHAT FLOWS THROUGH, taken off the top, on BOTH sides. It is no longer
folded into a marked-up or marked-down price. Premium revenue is routed OUT of the
treasury into a program-owned fee vault (the ATA of the fee_vault PDA), so the treasury
holds only backing. Sweep it with withdraw_fees(destination, amount).
fee_vault: MUST EXIST BEFORE public mint or redeem is opened. It is the associated token account
of the fee_vault PDA (seeds ["fee_vault"]) for the USDC mint, and mint_silv / redeem_silv
both require it, so a missing vault makes every mint and every redeem revert.
Create it once with createAssociatedTokenAccountIdempotent and allowOwnerOffCurve = true
(the owner is a PDA, so the client MUST pass that flag or it throws
TokenOwnerOffCurveError). Once created it can never be closed: closing needs the owner's
signature and the program never signs a CloseAccount for this PDA.
kyc_posture: SHIPPED BUT DORMANT. kyc_scope_flags = 0 at initialize, so KYC is required nowhere and
mint at launch needs no KYC. Arming it later is a config change, not a program upgrade
and not a second audit, which is the whole reason it ships now.
Arming sequence, and the ORDER MATTERS: (1) set_kyc_operator to the attestor key,
(2) let that key write attestations for existing holders, (3) set_kyc_scope. Doing (3)
first locks out every holder instantly, because none of them has an attestation yet.
Bit 0 = mint, bit 1 = redeem. Redeem-only (flags = 2) is the likely first step.
redeem_posture: Redemption is now a SINGLE INSTANT ROUTE. The T+3 queue, the per-size tier and the
off-chain settlement path are all deleted (which also deletes SolidProof MEDIUM #4).
ROUND 8: redemptions_enabled is TRUE at initialize. set_redemptions_enabled still refuses
true, so the asymmetry is unchanged: closing is instant on both lanes, and REOPENING after
a close rides the 24h-timelocked SetRedeemLimits action (propose_set_redeem_limits with
redemptions_enabled = Some(true), then execute). The path did not change; the starting
The global rolling budget (instant_redeem_budget_usdc over instant_redeem_window_seconds)
is KEPT and now REVERTS instead of routing to a queue. It is the only brake against the
whole treasury leaving in one transaction. Set treasury_min_float_usdc to a non-zero
value before opening redeem: it is the floor that stops withdraw_usdc from emptying the
redemption buffer, and fee revenue no longer accumulates there to cushion it.

_treasury_min_float_note: 0, DECIDE PAR THOMAS le 2026-08-07, en connaissance de cause.
Ce que ca veut dire: aucun plancher ne s oppose a un retrait admin, donc un retrait peut vider
la totalite de la tresorerie USDC, celle qui adosse les redemptions des utilisateurs. C est le
constat SolidProof LOW #4 et il reste OUVERT par choix.
Ce qui reste comme protection, et c est ce qui rend le choix defendable: withdraw_usdc est
TIMELOCKE (propose_set puis execute, 24 h) et le gardien peut l annuler pendant la fenetre. Un
retrait est donc annonce 24 h a l avance et vetoable. Le plancher n etait qu une seconde ceinture.
Il reste modifiable a tout moment par propose_/execute_set_treasury_min_float, donc ce n est pas
une decision irreversible: si le volume de redeem grossit, posez un plancher a ce moment-la.

2026-08-07, avec pour raison d observer le mint sous charge reelle avant d ouvrir la seule
CE QUI A CHANGE. Fermer ne coutait deja aucun jour (les horloges de 24 h tournent en

CONSEQUENCE OPERATIONNELLE, a connaitre avant d ouvrir le mint public: la config est un compte

_premint_custody_note: D11, DECIDE PAR THOMAS le 2026-08-09, sur recommandation, apres le constat P1 conditionnel du
tour 8 de Codex.
LE PROBLEME, et il n apparait QUE parce que les rachats s ouvrent au lancement.
config.inventory_wallet EkDhR65JUL8tGhxRhnueaqri6zNzxMEJ82UU35pQ7V56 est ON-CURVE, une cle a un
seul signataire. Verifie on-chain le 2026-08-09: PublicKey.isOnCurve == true. Tant que
redemptions_enabled valait false, cette cle valait du SILV et rien d autre. Une fois les rachats
ouverts, son detenteur signe redeem_silv lui-meme: pas d instruction admin, pas de redirection de
l inventory wallet, PAS DE TIMELOCK. L option A (inventory_wallet fixe a initialize, setter
instantane supprime) ferme le detournement du BINDING par l Ops; elle ne protege pas les tokens
deja detenus par la destination legitime.
Bloquer l adresse d inventaire dans redeem_silv ne fermerait rien: le SILV est fongible, il suffit
de le transferer ailleurs d abord.
LA SEULE BORNE CODE est le budget roulant, et il faut citer la VRAIE borne, pas la borne naive.
redeem_window.rs documente et teste qu un alignement adverse laisse sortir pres de 2x le budget
sur une tranche de longueur window. Avec les valeurs par defaut cela fait environ 40 000 USDC sur
24 h, pas 20 000, puis environ 20 000 par jour tant que personne ne pause. La pause et la
fermeture instantanee sont des reactions HUMAINES, pas un arret automatique.
LA DECISION, en deux volets.
1. NE PREMINTER QUE LA TRANCHE OPERATIONNELLE vers la cle chaude. admin_premint prend un montant;
rien n oblige a emettre 77% du cap le jour du lancement. Le cap est un plafond, pas un
objectif. On prereminte ce dont la pool a besoin, et on reprereminte plus tard au besoin.
La taille de cette tranche doit etre compatible avec la perte maximale acceptee sur le SLA de
detection et de reaction, CALCULEE AVEC LA BORNE 2x. CE NOMBRE EST UNE ENTREE DE THOMAS et il
n est pas encore fixe: ne pas l inventer ici.
2. LA RESERVE NE VA PAS DANS LA CLE CHAUDE. Le reste part vers un coffre Squads, ou n est pas
emis du tout. La note historique de ce meme fichier disait deja que la cle privee de ce wallet
vaut autant que le float et suggerait un coffre une fois la pool amorcee. Ouvrir les rachats
avance cette echeance au lancement.
CE QUE CETTE DECISION NE FERME PAS, et qui reste a la charge de l exploitation: l alerte
automatique sur RedeemEvent et sur la vitesse de consommation du budget, testee de bout en bout,
et un gardien independant capable de pauser dans un SLA mesure et REELLEMENT exerce. Sans ces
deux-la, la tranche operationnelle borne la perte mais personne ne la voit partir.

pinned       -> sha256/bytes/normalized_sha256 describe the one immutable artifact that ships.
Every gate compares against them and a mismatch is a hard failure.
TO PIN A CANDIDATE (runbook step 2c): create the mainnet program id, commit every address, let
the reproducible-build job produce the container binary at that exact SHA, then copy the four
fields BELOW from that job's output and set status to 'pinned'. Never from a local build:
SBF builds are not deterministic across host platforms (S-07, measured 2026-08-07).
TWO HASH CONVENTIONS COEXIST and mixing them produces a false pin. `sha256` is sha256sum of the
file. `normalized_sha256` is solana-verify's own hash (trailing zeros stripped, get_binary_hash),
which is what `verify-from-repo` compares against the chain. On the same macOS file those were
60c8a269... and 945fe91a...: different numbers for the same bytes.
